hook.name: LauncherHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook for Uniswap v4 that allows token creators to initialize ETH/token pools and seed one-sided (token-only) liquidity positions. The hook gates add/remove liquidity through a creator-only entry point backed by a pending-op pattern, while swaps execute as standard Uniswap v4 pool swaps with no hook intervention.
